| Keep an ed"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"itable source and build on the open-source code or generated HTML with your own interactions and use"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" cases. | Share a self-contained HTML file or export images, video, and share cards. |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The engineering behind the experience"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- **Layout judgment over generic auto-layout** — the agent chooses hierarchy, spacing, routes, and e"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"mphasis; shared automatic endpoints spread deterministically instead of piling arrows on one midpoin"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"t.
